source: LRO Diviner Polar Cumulative Products (PCP), bolometric temperature, south pole, 240 m/px, diurnal local-time bins, summer and winter (Williams et al. 2019, JGR Planets 124, 2505-2521); PDS Geosciences Node, lrodlr_1001/data/pcp/diurnal/ltim/pols
method: Mean bolometric temperature of the 28x28 km box centred on the site (5 sampled columns, 350-580 pixels per bin), for 8 of the 96 local-time bins (every 3 h) in summer and in winter; bins with under 200 pixels dropped (16 of 16 used). temp_min_K = coldest box mean; temp_daynight_range_K = mean over the two seasons of (warmest bin minus coldest bin). Measured; the box includes permanently shadowed ground
